title: Chapter 357 Unsealed Knife
content:
Chapter 357 Unsealed Knife

Going down the Chikuma River, about tens of miles along the way, passing through several small towns on the way, Kawanakajima, the famous place of chaos in the Shinano country, came into view.

There are many mountains around Chuanzhong Island, and there is a large lake. The terrain can be described as extremely complicated.

Asahiyama Castle at the foot of Mount Iizuna, as a mountain castle built on the basis of the most famous mountains in the Shinano country, has extremely strong defenses, and it is firmly stuck on the road to Shimadzu Castle for the troops present. It is an extremely strong fortress. nail.

In the Iigangshan mountain system, a rather winding path has become quite wide after being opened by the army, enough for four people to walk in unison.

On this road, a winding and straight army that stretches for more than ten miles is slowly moving forward, the flags cover the sky, and the blue dragon can't see the edge at a glance.

"Hurry up, there is Xushan City in front of you, after taking it down, you can rest enough if you want to rest."

Riding on a short Japanese horse, Tomita Yoshinari shouted to the soldiers beside him.

Hearing the command of their own general, the soldiers who originally had exhausted faces were shocked, their eyes were full of anticipation again, and there seemed to be infinite power gushing out of their bodies, and their footsteps sped up a little bit, quickly Go to the faintly visible small city ahead.

Since winning the previous victory in the battle of Iiyama Castle, Tomita Yoshinari can say it very comfortably in the past few days, and smiles often appear on his originally serious face.

Since the victory of the battle, the main force of the entire Shinano country has been defeated by him, and most of the active forces have been wiped out, which has caused the defense and resistance of the Shinano country to be greatly insufficient.

So when the remnants of the Shinano country retreated, the entire northern part of the Shinano country opened its arms to him.

Now, because of Zhong Yu's order, there is no need to worry about the reputation of the army or the maintenance of the place.

Therefore, Tomita Yoshisei directly ordered his soldiers to wantonly plunder the local tyrants in the northern region. This journey can be said to be paved with bones.

Of course, these are the corpses of those local Chinese.

Because too many people died in the previous battle, in order to restore morale, to ensure sufficient combat effectiveness of their own army.

Tomita Yoshinari issued an order not to seal the knife all the way.

Now those soldiers who were originally restrained by military discipline can be said to have ushered in a big carnival holiday.

In the past, the princess Ji Jun, a famous local tyrant that they could not hope for, will be abused by the untouchables who they looked down upon after becoming a loser.

Every time they saw these high-ranking figures wailing and crying under their respective crotches, these soldiers felt a strange pleasure in their hearts, and the desire to conquer had never been so strong.

Even anyone in the occupied area, as long as these soldiers are not pleasing to the eye, they can hack and kill at will, and no one will hold them accountable, and even the family of the person who was killed has to apologize, which is better than those high-ranking warriors in the past. big power.

There are also those enough rice, just for the incomparably delicious salted radish, and the delicious fish in the world, which they can hardly enjoy after joining the army of the dojo.

But now, as long as they ask for it from those ordinary local tyrants in their occupied areas, no one dares to refuse, even if they don't have it, they have to try their best to find it for themselves.

This kind of life really made these soldiers feel elated, and suddenly felt that their dignity was infinitely elevated, and the inferiority complex they originally felt because they had been untouchables for a long time also suddenly increased in reverse.

So what these soldiers did in the occupied area, such as playing with women, extorting property, setting fire to houses, etc., are considered light, and those soldiers are more benevolent.

There are really some perverts who take pleasure in killing captives, and casually use those fresh lives as their entertainment.

Among them, the most frequently played by these soldiers is stringing gourds. As the name suggests, they throw up children under the age of five, and then point out that the spears are their heads inserted straight from the mouth and burst out from the back of the head. One by one, these soldiers were quite fascinated.

Another one is sashimi.

Many people know that the Japanese like to eat sashimi and so on, so they also tell other creatures that this hobby takes the lead.

And people have been called two-legged sheep since ancient times. Raw sheep slices are a living person who is washed, stunned with anesthetics or simply stunned and placed on a large table, and then a group of soldiers use it Serve with a knife and fork.

The reason for this habit is that cannibalism is of great benefit to their practice.

Every time they eat more meat, the blood essence and evil spirit contained in it can boost their cultivation and greatly enhance the power of their internal energy.

Among them, raw meat is the best, without any damage, the menstrual blood resentment contained in it is the strongest, and the effect is also the strongest.

This was premeditated by Zhong Yu before doing the exercises under the bed.

He came to this world mainly to recover his strength, and in order to recover quickly, he chose to kill him as an effective method.

That's why Zhong Yu issued the order to completely eradicate the tyrants before, just to force these tyrants to use their influence in various places to mobilize enough manpower to fight against him.

The more people there are, the more people will die, and the more lucky people will gain.

Today is no exception. Turning all the soldiers under his command into man-eating demons can not only quickly increase their murderous aura, but also hone their character.

It can even cultivate their habit of cannibalism. When the time comes, they will not be happy with anyone. For the sake of their own belly, they will take the initiative to find someone to kill without Zhong Yu's order.

This is another excellent way to harvest luck points.

The army walking on the mountain road is still moving forward, but the speed is indeed a bit faster than before. After all, there is temptation, and these soldiers have a lot of motivation.

Many soldiers were even thinking about how to treat the villagers there when they arrived at Xushan City.

"Well, it is necessary to present beautiful women, and I count on them to warm the bed at night. There are also several bowls of fragrant rice, and it is best to add a little salted radish."

These soldiers thought so in their hearts.

At the same time, on the mountain where the army was walking, where countless waves of scouts had been sent out to investigate, suddenly several black shadows appeared, surrounded by countless black mist.

Each of these black shadows stared at the advancing army below, their eyes were gloomy, and there was even a hint of murderous intent flickering in the depths, but they did not attack immediately, but instead turned their attention to one of them who was the leader. people.

This person was also a black shadow, covered in black mist, and completely disappeared in the forest that blocked the sunlight.
